page.layout: One column of running text; a short paragraph ending the previous article at the top, then a centred article heading with a title line below it, then the body. Running head top centre, page number top left, catchword bottom right.

main_text.p: premat aquam jam factam potabilem, ubicunque tandem edulcoretur.
Alia quoque gravis est difficultas in illa matis collatione[?], quam non opinor animadvertisse[?] Scaligerum quamque suo loco propositam, Deo dante, re-solvemus.
main_text.head: ARTICULUS V. Quomodo aqua marina surgant in fontes.
main_text.p: QUO igitur vehiculo scandunt aquae maris factae subterraneae, si quidem id Scaliger ignotavit; Id non debuit esse obscurum ei qui viderat aquam igne submisso per evaporationem ascendere, eandemque rursus obice facto-condensatam, pristina forma recepta recidere. Est enim imis terrae penetralibus ignis intestinus qui ut mineralia, metalla, aliaque permulta concoquit, ita aquam subiens eandem sursum vehit in vapores, qui si petreum retinaculum inveniant, in aquam resoluti quaerunt exitum. Quo plures autem atque copiosiores stillae ejusmodi ex pluribus locis in unum confluxerint, eo uberior fit scaturigo.

Ad scaturiginem ergo requiritur ut ascensus vaporum ab imo fit facilis, alioquin si impeditus, resoluti identidem cadunt, haud secus ac in olla videmus fumos ab operculo retentos, resolutosque recidere. Necesse est praeterea, ut ii vapores in altum evecti duritie, atque densitate loci cohibeantur. Ob primam causam, terra pinguis quod renacior, ac densior minus scaturit fontibus, sed puteis apta. Ob secundam, solum arenosum minus aptum fonticulis, nisi aliunde descendant. Quod vero saxosum est ac praedurum in summitate, quia inferius arenosum, vel plures, ac faciles habet hiatus, spiracula, id solum aquarum scatebris oportunum.

page.notes: Mostly clear. Doubtful readings: "matis" (line 1 of the second paragraph, may be a word such as "materiae" misread) and "animadvertisse" (the printed form looks like "afimadvertisse", with the "ni" faint). "facto-condensatam" has an uncertain mark between the words. "renacior" is kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "furgant" read as "surgant", "furfum" as "sursum"). A small mark "1" sits at the very foot of the page, centred; it is not treated as a signature. The large initial Q of "QUO" is joined to the following letters.
